# PRD: Authentication

## User Stories

### Capability Area: User Management

FR1: Users can sign up

| ID | As a... | I want to... | So that... | Priority | Status |
|----|---------|--------------|------------|----------|--------|
| S1.1 | new user | sign up with email | I can access the app | must | not started |
| S1.2 | new user | verify my email | my account is secure | should | in spec |

FR2: Users can recover passwords

| ID | As a... | I want to... | So that... | Priority | Status |
|----|---------|--------------|------------|----------|--------|
| S2.1 | existing user | reset my password | I regain access | must | not started |
